Working priorities · to agree together

This summary draws on six submissions across the English and Chinese forms, as of 19 October. The forms are anonymous and separate, so submissions may overlap. These are issues to explore, not a representative survey of all PGR students.

04 / Daily research life

Space & access

Reliable workspace, storage and clear routes to evening access.

Agree the route and the responsible team ↗ 05 / Research support

Compute & funding

Understand HPC/GPU allocations, application progress and available research funding.

Make the support routes clear ↗ 06 / Community & EDI

Belonging across sites

Include PGRs across locations through better notice, accessible formats and shared information.

Choose a practical next step ↗

Keep what works. Feedback also recognises prompt help with day-to-day School issues and useful induction talks that introduce research resources.

The running order

The 90-minute
conversation.

Add to calendar ↓

Items 04–06 turn the feedback into specific questions. Expand any item for the evidence, the request and the follow-up to agree. Times, priorities and chairing roles remain proposals for the representatives to confirm.

0111:305 minutesWelcome & introductionsSet the direction for our conversation.+
Purpose

Welcome everyone, introduce the representatives and agree the agenda.

In the room
  • Who is joining in person and online?
  • Are there any additions or urgent items?
  • Confirm chairing roles and who is recording actions.

Leave with An agreed running order and clear meeting roles.

0211:3510 minutesPrevious actionsStart with what has changed.+
Purpose

Review the latest action list and identify any items that need follow-up.

Questions to ask
  • What has been completed since the last meeting?
  • Which actions are still open, and what is the next step?
  • Do owners or target dates need to be updated?

Leave with An updated action list, with the status of outstanding items confirmed.

0311:4510 minutesSchool & Faculty updatesPut the discussion in context.+
Purpose

Hear relevant updates from the School, Faculty and support services.

Invited updates
  • Changes or opportunities that affect PGR students.
  • Relevant Library and IT information, if representatives are attending.
  • Where students can find further information or support.

Leave with Key updates and useful information to share with the PGR community.

0411:5530 minutesThe student perspectiveWorkspace, access and the practicalities of research.+
Purpose

Bring the practical conditions of daily research to the forum, while recognising the support that already works.

A dependable place to work

What we heardFeedback describes uncertainty around fixed workspaces and the disruption of hot-desking.

Question for the forum
  • What workspace and storage options are available to PGRs, and how should students raise unmet needs?

Follow-up ownerRelevant School operations or workspace team — confirm at the meeting.

Clear access arrangements

What we heardFeedback asks for clarity on evening and out-of-hours access at Temple Quarter.

Question for the forum
  • What access is available, what approval or card steps are needed, and where can PGRs find the process?

Follow-up ownerRelevant building or access team — confirm at the meeting.

Confirm the current arrangements first; do not assume every concern is shared by all students or still unresolved.

Leave with A clear workspace and access route, with the responsible contact and a date for communicating it.

0512:2510 minutesResearch support & developmentCompute allocations, funding and routes to support.+
Purpose

Make the steps for accessing research resources easier to understand and follow.

HPC, GPU and AIRR applications

What we heardFeedback asks about compute allocations, progress on applications and options when an existing allocation is insufficient.

Question for the forum
  • Can the School clarify application and top-up routes, who can check a delayed application, and whether any additional or temporary allocation routes are available?

Follow-up ownerResearch computing / relevant allocation team — confirm the contact.

Finding research funding

What we heardFeedback asks where to find funding opportunities, eligibility, available support and application steps.

Question for the forum
  • Can PGRs be pointed to one maintained source covering eligibility, support available, deadlines and a named contact?

Follow-up ownerRelevant research or PGR support team — confirm the contact.

Allocation sizes, capacity and waiting times have not been independently established. Ask the responsible teams to explain the current position. Invite any additional training, supervision or progression support needs.

Leave with A published support route for each issue, plus an owner and update date for unresolved questions.

0612:3515 minutesCommunity, events & EDIMake participation work across locations and workloads.+
Purpose

Help PGR students across sites and cohorts access the same information and opportunities.

Participation across sites

What we heardFeedback highlights the need for stronger connections beyond Clifton, including BRL and Temple Quarter. Research and teaching commitments, travel and short notice can limit participation.

Question for the forum
  • Could activities be announced earlier, use suitable times, rotate locations or offer remote participation? What is the best shared channel for workspace and community information?

Follow-up ownerRepresentatives and relevant event organisers — agree ownership.

Build on what helps

What we heardInduction talks that introduce resources are valued. Existing seminar, retreat and community ideas can help maintain those connections.

Question for the forum
  • Which practical activity or information improvement should we take forward first? Discuss the proposed PGR LinkedIn page only if time permits, with a clear purpose and willing owner.

Follow-up ownerRepresentatives / relevant School team — to agree.

The LinkedIn page remains a proposal; creation and approval have not been agreed.

Leave with One feasible community improvement, an agreed lead and a way to check whether it reaches PGRs across sites.

0712:5010 minutesAgree what happens nextTurn the conversation into commitments.+
Purpose

Review the decisions and actions, and confirm how the outcomes will be communicated.

Before we close
  • Who owns each action, and when will they report back?
  • Which items should be raised at Faculty SARF?
  • How will we share an update with students?

Leave with Named action owners, follow-up dates and a plan for reporting back.

13:00 · Meeting closeFrom discussion to follow-through.

Before we meet

Bring a perspective.
And a possibility.

The forms remain open before and after the forum. Add a concern, an improvement or something that works well. Please avoid names or details that could identify another person.
